main_text.l: Ut autē videat viscida aliunde quàm
desari, Spiritûs ex.gr. Nitri dulcis pa-
rum misceat cum albumine ovi & op-
pidò illud attenuatum videbit. quod si
illi permisceat ; & è vestigio in consi-
tionem non fieri vi caloris aut frigoris
nemo negaverit: cùm in aëre calidior
menta, sine mutatione caloris aut fri-
goris à solo spirituoso acido dulci , &
nem facit, quàm belle hic Doctor sui

l.i: quam densari hoc phlegma , quod tame-
& contabescat, ostendam. εἰ ἂν ἔπηξε ἡ πέπε ψυχρὸν λύσει; ὅτω γὰρ τὸ αὐτὸ ἀλλὰ ἔχει αὐτὸ

page.notes: The right portion of the lines is cut off by the scan; the Greek at the end of the page is partly illegible and was transcribed approximately. Lines of the last Greek fragment are doubtful.
